<issue_description>
Heap-based buffer overflow (out-of-bounds read) in the BMP decoder (load-bmp.c) within bmp_read_color_profile. Insufficient validation of the ICC/profile offset and size can cause the code to copy profile data past the provided image buffer (seen in fz_new_buffer_from_copied_data / memcpy), leading to crashes and potential memory disclosure or denial-of-service.
